literal: Resources, instrument, time, action, along with place—all five, darkness being cleared, having analyzed, to act.
translation: Analyze these five factors thoroughly until all doubts are cleared before embarking on an action: the required resources, the proper instruments, the right time, the nature of the action, and the suitable place.
modern: தேவையான பொருள், தகுந்த கருவி, ஏற்ற காலம், செய்ய வேண்டிய செயல், அதற்குரிய இடம் ஆகிய ஐந்தையும் ஐயமற ஆராய்ந்து ஒரு செயலைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the five essential prerequisites for executing any task successfully. The five factors are the necessary resources (poruḷ), the appropriate tools or instruments (karuvi), the right timing (kālam), the nature of the deed itself (viṉai), and the proper location (iṭam). The phrase 'iruḷ tīra' (darkness being cleared) metaphorically refers to dispelling all doubts and ignorance. The poet advises that one must analyze all five elements with absolute clarity before initiating any action.
